import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def phase3_simulation(N=24750, eps=1e-51):
    # N nodos distribuidos en 2D
    xy = np.random.rand(N, 2)

    # amplitudes iniciales
    Z = 0.6 + 0.1*np.random.randn(N)

    # infifoton activations
    infi_hits = np.random.poisson(1.0, N)
    Z += infi_hits * eps * 1e12   # escala TTA

    # coherencia
    Phi = 1 - np.var(Z)

    # mapa 2D
    plt.figure(figsize=(6,6))
    plt.scatter(xy[:,0], xy[:,1], c=Z, cmap='inferno', s=3)
    plt.colorbar(label="Amplitude (Z)")
    plt.title(f"Phase 3 / CMB-like map\nΦ={Phi:.4f}")
    plt.savefig("phase3_CMBlike.png")

    return Z, Phi, infi_hits

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def phase4_simulation(N=25000, eps=1e-51):
    # nodos en 3D
    xyz = np.random.rand(N, 3)

    # amplitudes iniciales
    Z = 0.7 + 0.2*np.random.randn(N)

    # infifotones: evento de densificación
    infi_hits = np.random.poisson(2.0, N)
    Z += infi_hits * eps * 1e14   # alta fase TTA

    # interacción nodal
    Z = np.abs(np.fft.fft(Z))     # fractalidad
    Z = Z / np.max(Z)

    Phi = 1 - np.var(Z)

    # plot
    plt.figure(figsize=(7,7))
    ax = plt.axes(projection='3d')
    ax.scatter(xyz[:,0], xyz[:,1], xyz[:,2], c=Z, cmap='viridis', s=1)
    plt.title(f"Phase 4 / 3D fractal\nΦ={Phi:.4f}")
    plt.savefig("phase4_3Dfractal.png")

    return Z, Phi, infi_hits
